findings.reason: The protected source uses the generic local name index for the active gene position, contrary to the campaign's interview-naming standard. The candidate uses the conventional position variable i and character variable c, which make the mutation expression and unchanged-character check direct.

The protected source initializes unvisited from the bank without discarding startGene. When the valid start is also listed, a cycle can enqueue and process the source one redundant time, so the stated visit-at-most-once invariant is not exact. The candidate discards startGene before BFS and then removes every other gene when it is enqueued.

With those focused corrections, the inert candidate is a concise, conventional BFS over implicitly generated one-character mutations. The queue carries explicit distances, the unvisited set is the complete visited-state mechanism, early target rejection is contract-derived, and no additional abstraction would improve interview clarity.
